description: Alpha Agent Stage 8 - autonomous data exhaustion, never-idle research queue, watchdog and secure Telegram control plane. RESEARCH AUTOMATION ONLY. Never creates orders, fills, signals, trade decisions, model promotions, Alpha Paper Book changes, Paper Trader DB writes or Daily Close triggers; never runs the prediction service or PostgreSQL. Contains NO secret - only DPAPI credential-store LOCATIONS and non-secret numeric allowlist file references; the Telegram bot token lives exclusively in Windows DPAPI storage outside this repository and the allowed numeric ids live in a non-secret file outside this repository.

operating_principles.exhaustive_data: Exhaust every owned and every legally accessible free source before declaring a signal family blocked; classify every missing field with an exact source attempt and reason.
operating_principles.never_idle: Never voluntarily enter a terminal research-complete / nothing-to-do / waiting-for-user state while useful work remains possible; keep at least one next useful action in the durable queue; one blocked lane never stops the others; a sent report is never terminal.

collect_drain.note: Stage 9.3 (controlled evidence campaigns) - bounded canonical-queue drain integrated into the scheduled AlphaAgent-Collect cycle. It runs in TWO passes and executes AT MOST ONE job per cycle. PASS A (unchanged Stage-9.2 allowlist): approved Stage-9 tournament-continuation work via the three ANDed dimensions allowed_origins AND allowed_lane_prefixes AND allowed_categories; ineligible/legacy jobs are never claimed, transitioned or counted, and an empty allowlist executes nothing. PASS B (Stage 9.3 CONTROLLED SEC CONTINUATION - Option 2): runs ONLY when pass A claimed nothing, and admits the SEC campaign's own self-continuation (origin campaign-continuation) but STRICTLY scoped by sec_continuation.allowed_* to the EXACT triple origin=campaign-continuation AND lane=acq.sec_form4_8k AND category=DATA_ACQUISITION. Because the three claim_next dimensions are ANDed, a campaign-continuation job on any OTHER lane or category is never claimable - no other campaign-continuation lane may execute. The proven Stage-9.2 claim_next is NOT modified; scoping is expressed entirely by the two allowlists. The SEC handler enforces, INLINE and from the durable append-only campaign_batch log (restart-safe), a per-UTC-day completed-batch cap (daily_completed_batch_cap) and a consecutive-no-progress stop (max_consecutive_no_progress_batches): it declines to run and does NOT chain a continuation when the campaign is complete, the daily cap is reached, or the no-progress limit is reached; a progress batch chains the next continuation only while under the daily cap and incomplete; a no-progress (blocked) batch never chains. AUDIT: attempts increments exactly once per real execution at CLAIM time, so an executed job shows attempts>=1. EXECUTION CONTAINMENT (SAFE TIMEOUT, retained): every handler runs INLINE on the drain thread - there is NO worker/daemon thread and nothing is abandoned, so the queue lease is settled strictly AFTER the handler returns. Internally-bounded handlers only: DATA_VALIDATION (weakest-gate) is LOCAL owned-coverage measurement (no network); acq.sec_form4_8k has a finite batch (sec_cik_batch_size=20 CIKs) and finite per-request network timeouts (stage2 http_timeout_seconds=30 x max_retries), and honours handler_time_budget_seconds by stopping BETWEEN bounded network requests and returning RETRYABLE (partial batch NOT recorded; no batch-log row; resumes next cycle; bounded by max_attempts). handler_time_budget_seconds and daily_completed_batch_cap are COOPERATIVE, inline, handler-enforced bounds, NOT hard process kills; budget_seconds only prevents STARTING a new job once the per-cycle wall-clock is spent. The HARD, OS-enforced ceilings are the task ExecutionTimeLimit (PT20M) and MultipleInstancesPolicy=IgnoreNew; the runtime collect lock refuses a second in-host collect; an OS kill mid-handler leaves the job RUNNING (never settled) for requeue_stale to recover. Absent/false = disabled (offline + acceptance/test configs never drain); true here = production default. Durable lease semantics: a claimed job is RUNNING and cannot be double-claimed; a restart resumes leased/retryable work and the same campaign batch.
collect_drain.stage10_2_note: Stage 10.2 HISTORICAL PIT FUNDAMENTALS. PASS A's allowlist is broadened by EXACTLY the single new origin stage10.2-fundamentals and the single new lane prefix fundamentals. (nothing else); the categories DATA_ACQUISITION/DATA_VALIDATION are UNCHANGED (already admitted). Because the three claim_next dimensions are ANDed, this admits ONLY the AlphaAgent's own Stage 10.2 downstream jobs (origin=stage10.2-fundamentals AND lane GLOB fundamentals.* AND category in {DATA_ACQUISITION,DATA_VALIDATION}). The campaign is FINITE (one companyfacts archive + the bounded resolved-CIK universe measured once per epoch) and runs at a lower priority (4) than the identity backlog (6) and companyfacts bootstrap (5), so it can never permanently starve the tournament, and the companyfacts fairness promotion still runs PASS C ahead of PASS A when due. max_jobs_per_cycle stays 1. The historical fundamental experiment itself is generated by the tournament tick when the measured activation gate opens - never enqueued by this campaign.

collect_drain.stage10_note: Stage 10 HISTORICAL IDENTITY. PASS A's allowlist is broadened by EXACTLY the single new origin stage10-identity and the single new lane prefix identity. The identity backlog is FINITE (bounded survivorship universe x fixed rebalance dates) and the post-drain maintenance is a THROTTLED low-priority (1) tail measured once per coverage-epoch, so identity can never permanently starve the tournament; and the companyfacts fairness promotion still runs PASS C ahead of PASS A when due (skipping PASS A entirely), so identity can never starve the companyfacts continuation. max_jobs_per_cycle stays 1.
collect_drain.stage9_4_note: Stage 9.4 release closure adds EXPERIMENT to PASS A's category allowlist ONLY. Combined with the UNCHANGED allowed_origins (stage9-tournament / stage9-weakest-gate) and allowed_lane_prefixes (tournament. / acq.sec_form4_8k), which are ANDed inside claim_next, this admits ONLY tournament-generated canonical experiments (origin=stage9-tournament AND lane GLOB tournament.* AND category=EXPERIMENT) - chiefly the bounded tournament.stage9_4_revalidation jobs the tick generates. A legacy EXPERIMENT job with any other origin or lane is still never claimable. max_jobs_per_cycle stays 1; claim_next orders priority DESC so a priority-3 experiment is claimed before a priority-2 weakest-gate validation. The revalidation handler runs INLINE on the owned Norgate panel (local, no network) and returns a single-feature Stage 5 row the next tick ingests exactly once.
collect_drain.stage9_5_note: Stage 9.5 adds the EXACT lane acq.sec_companyfacts to PASS A's allowed_lane_prefixes ONLY (still ANDed with allowed_origins stage9-weakest-gate + category DATA_ACQUISITION). This admits ONLY the companyfacts campaign BOOTSTRAP job (origin=stage9-weakest-gate AND lane=acq.sec_companyfacts AND category=DATA_ACQUISITION) that the weakest-gate / bootstrap seeder enqueues at a priority above the tournament experiments so the live companyfacts acquisition actually runs; the SELF-CONTINUATIONS (origin=campaign-continuation) are admitted separately and EXACTLY by companyfacts_continuation below (PASS C). No other campaign-continuation lane or category is claimable by either. Nothing operational is mutated.

sec_continuation.note: Stage 9.3 controlled SEC Form 4 / 8-K campaign-continuation. Admitted ONLY for the exact scoped triple below; the daily_completed_batch_cap and max_consecutive_no_progress_batches are enforced inline by _run_sec_cik_campaign from the durable campaign_batch log. Set enabled=false to revert to the Stage-9.2 Option-1 paused policy.

companyfacts_continuation.note: Stage 9.5 CONTROLLED SEC companyfacts campaign-continuation (PASS C). Runs ONLY when pass A and pass B both claimed nothing (so at most ONE job still executes per cycle) and admits EXACTLY the scoped triple origin=campaign-continuation AND lane=acq.sec_companyfacts AND category=DATA_ACQUISITION. Because the three claim_next dimensions are ANDed, no other campaign-continuation lane/category is claimable here. batch_size (default 5) and max_batch_size (hard 10) bound the per-batch CIK count; daily_completed_batch_cap (<=4 completed batches/UTC day) and max_consecutive_no_progress_batches (stop after 2 stalled batches) are DERIVED from the durable append-only campaign_batch log (restart-safe) and enforced INLINE by _run_companyfacts_campaign - it declines to run and does NOT chain when complete/capped/stalled; a progress batch chains the next continuation only while incomplete and under the daily cap; a no-progress batch never chains. bootstrap_priority (5) is the priority the seeder / weakest-gate use for the FIRST (origin=stage9-weakest-gate) job so the live acquisition runs ahead of the tournament experiments. first_concepts overrides the collector companyfacts_concepts with the exact Stage 9.5 concept scope. The companyfacts lane fetches ONLY per-CIK XBRL companyfacts (collect_companyfacts) - the daily-index / form4 / 8-K / submissions lanes are switched off for this campaign so each batch stays bounded to the CIK companyfacts documents. Set enabled=false to keep Stage 9.5 acquisition deferred.
companyfacts_continuation.fairness_note: Stage 9.5 DETERMINISTIC FAIRNESS. PASS C is claimable only when PASS A and PASS B are idle, but the Stage 9.4 tournament revalidation loop registers one PASS-A job every cycle, so without a fairness rule PASS C could wait an unbounded number of cycles. run_fair_drain (alpha_agent/drain_fairness.py) counts, in a durable restart-safe sqlite under the Stage 8 autonomy root (scheduler_fairness.sqlite - NOT an operational-ledger file, so the ledger digest is unaffected), the completed collect cycles since the companyfacts continuation last executed. Once that idle count reaches fairness_max_idle_cycles it PROMOTES PASS C ahead of PASS A for ONE cycle (still exactly one job, max_jobs_per_cycle stays 1, the exact origin/lane/category scope is unchanged) - but ONLY if an eligible continuation is queued AND the campaign is not stopped, so the daily_completed_batch_cap and max_consecutive_no_progress_batches ALWAYS win over fairness. Executing the continuation resets the counter, so the promotion fires at most once per (fairness_max_idle_cycles + 1) cycles and the tournament experiments are never permanently starved. Set fairness_enabled=false to revert to the pure pass-A-first order.

stage10_identity.note: Stage 10 HISTORICAL IDENTITY LAYER. The survivorship-safe, effective-dated security identity + security->CIK mapping infrastructure the AlphaAgent operates through the SAME research queue + fair scheduler to close HISTORICAL_FUNDAMENTAL_UNIVERSE_NOT_READY. Claude builds the reusable capability (extraction, store, matching contract, universe service, coverage, jobs, planner, readiness integration); the AlphaAgent prioritizes/creates/claims/executes the jobs and re-evaluates readiness. The canonical identity store + immutable artifacts live under the Stage 8 research root on D: (NEVER an operational-ledger root). RESEARCH-ONLY: never an order/fill/signal/trade-decision/model-promotion/paper-book/Daily-Close; never runs prediction or PostgreSQL. The safety diagnostic stays until the MEASURED historical mapping coverage over the full survivorship-safe universe (current + delisted) passes the configured threshold - aggregate current-CIK coverage can never unlock it. Claude never flips the safety switch.

tournament.note: Stage 9 Autonomous Alpha Tournament. The bounded tournament tick is the highest-value research step of the production cycle (run_autonomy_cycle(..., run_tournament=True)); it shares THIS durable queue and never creates a second framework. READ-ONLY w.r.t. the operating portfolio; no automatic promotion.

production_handlers.note: Real Stage 2/5/6 handlers: each durable-queue category acquires real data or runs a real bounded experiment and returns genuine evidence (record counts, coverage deltas, rank-IC, gate decisions). Research-only; never writes an operational ledger.

production.note: WS2 — TWO explicit run modes. Scheduled production tasks resolve run_mode=production and dynamically shard the COMPLETE eligible research universe (Norgate survivorship-safe 'S&P 500 Current & Past' incl. delisted). A per-job batch size is permitted; a permanent total-universe cap is NOT. The six-symbol 'bounded_universe' above is the ACCEPTANCE fixture (tests / smoke / manual acceptance) and is never selected by a scheduled task. Durable cursors + repair queues live in the campaign store; each completed batch enqueues the next (autonomous continuation).

production_universe_source.note: licensed Norgate survivorship-safe universe: current + past S&P 500 constituents INCLUDING delisted securities for point-in-time research

campaigns.note: Stage 9.5 dedicated live per-CIK SEC companyfacts (XBRL) acquisition; drives ONLY the sec_edgar collect_companyfacts lane with the Stage 9.5 concept scope; own cursor + own daily/no-progress caps (autonomy.collect_drain.companyfacts_continuation). universe_scope=current: the free SEC company_tickers.json maps ONLY current entities to CIKs, so the acquisition universe is the current S&P 500 constituents (each fact still carries its own SEC filed date = PIT availability; the survivorship-safe delisted tickers have no current CIK map and are honestly not acquirable via this free lane).
